Stepping out, repping the best of Nelson, this flavour boasting, malt toasting IPA packs style and grace with hip hops dancing on a balanced bitter-clean finish. Big Hoppa stacks Riwaka, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka for a tropical blast of passionfruit, gooseberry and citrus that hits from first crack to last sip.

Four malts back it up with just enough body, letting the hops do their things before a crisp, bitter-clean finish cuts through with lime and a touch of herb. It's fresh, punchy and built to flow - an IPA with style, balance and serious presence. No overthinking, just proper flavour done right.

IPA is king, Big Hoppa holds the crown. It’s all good, and if you don’t know, now you know!


History
Terry McCashin began making the Mac’s naturally brewed beer in 1981 at the old Rochdale cider factory in Nelson. Today even though Terry’s moved on, we remain determined to keep his combination of quality and ingenuity alive.

det.description:
In 1958, the Black Budget taxed the best beers in the world out of our reach – so we decided to brew our own.

To prove it was one of the finest in the world we entered the World Cup of beers, the ‘Les Amis du Vin’ and won.

To make sure it wasn’t a fluke we entered again the next year and won, we did that for four years straight.

Then, on the eve of the fifth, legend has it, the organisers wrote to ask us not to enter. Proof that when it comes to the finest beers in the world, they considered Steinlager Classic unbeatable.

The beer is the same today as it was then.

Steinlager Classic has a robust hop nose of fresh-cut green grass and a full flavour delivered by the Green Bullet hop, grown in Nelson at 41 degrees latitude, the perfect hop-growing location. The body of Steinlager Classic delivers a full flavour that is perfectly balanced with a dry, tangy finish and crisp clean bitterness.

New Zealand’s Finest.

Sensitivity can occur when the dentine underneath tooth enamel and gums becomes exposed. When exposed dentine comes into contact with hot or cold, sweet or sour, or even your toothbrush, it can trigger the nerve causing a short sharp pain.

Sensodyne is proven to relieve sensitive teeth, and with twice daily brushing everyday, it provides 24/7 protection from sensitivity, plus all the benefits you would expect from a daily toothpaste - strong teeth, healthy gums and fresh breath.

det.description:
99% carb free, and 100% secret.

Timing, they say, is everything.

Making a low carb beer without losing body and taste is the trick every brew master tries to perfect.

The subtle addition of hops and Munich Malt helps.

But the trick is all in the timing. Stop the fermentation too soon and the flavour will be there but the carbs will be too. Stop the fermentation too late and the carbs will be gone, but so will the flavour. The art of stopping the fermentation process at exactly the moment when the flavour is fullest and the carbs are the lowest is the secret.

And naturally if we told you exactly when that was, we’d have to kill you.

Steinlager Ultra Low Carb is brewed with New Zealand Pilsner and Munich malts and then fermented to completion. A touch of hop flavour and bitterness combines to deliver a crisp and refreshing taste.

New Zealand’s Finest.

Awards: New Zealand Beer Awards 2026 - Gold

Reassuringly crafted by Mt Difficulty, Roaring Meg wines are stylish and contemporary Central Otago wines that are vivacious and approachable.
The colourful story of Roaring Meg comes from Central Otago's pioneering past. The discovery of gold in the 1860s attracted many young men to Central Otago in search of their fortune. det.description:
In 1958, the Black Budget taxed the best beers in the world out of our reach – so we decided to brew our own.

To prove it was one of the finest in the world we entered the World Cup of beers, the ‘Les Amis du Vin’ and won.

To make sure it wasn’t a fluke we entered again the next year and won, we did that for four years straight.

Then, on the eve of the fifth, legend has it, the organisers wrote to ask us not to enter. Proof that when it comes to the finest beers in the world, they considered Steinlager Classic unbeatable.

The beer is the same today as it was then.

Steinlager Classic has a robust hop nose of fresh-cut green grass and a full flavour delivered by the Green Bullet hop, grown in Nelson at 41 degrees latitude, the perfect hop-growing location. The body of Steinlager Classic delivers a full flavour that is perfectly balanced with a dry, tangy finish and crisp clean bitterness.

New Zealand’s Finest.

Awards: New Zealand Beer Awards 2026 - Gold - NZ Lager & Pilsner

Sweat, also known as perspiration, is a normal and healthy bodily function, and it starts to occur just a few months after birth. We mainly sweat to cool our bodies down, a process called thermoregulation. Our brain sends a signal to over 3 million glands in our body to release sweat. With motion activated sweat protection, our products are intelligently designed to work as hard as you do. We make it our business to know more about sweat, and what we learn informs every product innovation.

Sweat, also known as perspiration, is a normal and healthy bodily function and it starts to occur just a few months after birth. We mainly sweat to cool our bodies down, a process called thermoregulation. Our brain sends a signal to over 3 million glands in our body to release sweat (a clear fluid made of water, salts and proteins). As this fluid evaporates from our skin, it lowers our body temperature.

99% carb free, and 100% secret.

Timing, they say, is everything.

Making a low carb beer without losing body and taste is the trick every brew master tries to perfect.

The subtle addition of hops and Munich Malt helps.

But the trick is all in the timing. Stop the fermentation too soon and the flavour will be there but the carbs will be too. Stop the fermentation too late and the carbs will be gone, but so will the flavour. The art of stopping the fermentation process at exactly the moment when the flavour is fullest and the carbs are the lowest is the secret.

And naturally if we told you exactly when that was, we’d have to kill you.

Steinlager Ultra Low Carb is brewed with New Zealand Pilsner and Munich malts and then fermented to completion. A touch of hop flavour and bitterness combines to deliver a crisp and refreshing taste.

New Zealand’s Finest.

Alcohol free beer just got cooler.

11 degrees cooler.

A typical lager is fermented at 9-13 degrees, Steinlager Alcohol Free is fermented at close to zero.

The low temp inhibits the production of alcohol. It’s a bit of brewmaster genius that delivers an alcohol free beer with uncompromised taste.

So, if ordering an alcohol free Steiny suddenly feels way cooler, you now know why.

For those who enjoy the crisp, refreshing taste of Steinlager without the alcohol, Steinlager Alcohol Free delivers everything you love about the iconic brew—minus the buzz. With a light malt character, a touch of bitterness, and that signature crisp finish, this alcohol-free version allows you to enjoy the perfect balance of flavour and a refreshing full bodied beer any time of day.

New Zealand’s Finest.

*Contains no more than 0.5% alc/vol.

We make it our business to know more about sweat, and what we learn informs every product innovation. Sweat, also known as perspiration, is a normal and healthy bodily function and it starts to occur just a few months after birth. We mainly sweat to cool our bodies down, a process called thermoregulation. Our brain sends a signal to over 3 million glands in our body to release sweat.
